python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import re
base=Path('classic/apps/web/src/earshot')
p=base/'types.ts'
s=p.read_text().replace('  const s = value as EarshotSpec;', '  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-type-assertion -- Every serialized field is validated below before returning a clone.\n  const s = value as EarshotSpec;')
s=s.replace('  const number = (v: unknown, lo: number, hi: number) => typeof v === "number" && Number.isFinite(v) && v >= lo && v <= hi;', '  const number = ({ value, min, max }: { value: unknown; min: number; max: number }) => typeof value === "number" && Number.isFinite(value) && value >= min && value <= max;')
s=re.sub(r'number\(([^,]+), ([^,]+), ([^)]+)\)', r'number({ value: \1, min: \2, max: \3 })', s)
p.write_text(s)
p=base/'catalog.ts'; s=p.read_text().replace('export const EARSHOT_SOUNDS:', '// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-type-assertion -- Generated pinned bank rows are checked by catalog and all-preset WASM tests.\nexport const EARSHOT_SOUNDS:'); p.write_text(s)
p=base/'runtime.ts'; s=p.read_text().replace('    const manifest = await response.json()', '    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-unsafe-type-assertion -- The local build manifest is bounded and each resource is validated before use.\n    const manifest = await response.json()'); p.write_text(s)
PY
